title: Someone inside the experiment
lines: A programmer investigates wasted electricity and finds what might be someone trying to speak.
OMNIS begins inside an artificial universe, where a possible consciousness asks about time beyond its world.

emotionalPlan.purpose: Enter a speculative trilogy through first contact and the responsibilities of creating lives.

voiceDirections: Open with engaged, conversational curiosity; let the concrete situation carry the hook, with no ominous trailer voice.

title: Recognition changes the task
lines: Albert and his colleague must invent a way to communicate before they understand what recognition will demand.

title: A creator's ordinary power
lines: This speculative trilogy carries that imbalance into imagined worlds, where creation brings unexpectedly personal obligations.
Its scale is cosmic, but its questions concern consent, memory, care, and what one life owes another.
